description: Open the hemoglobin beta protein FASTA file (hemoglobin_beta_multispecies.fasta) located at ~/UGENE_Data/ in UGENE. This file contains real hemoglobin beta subunit protein sequences from 8 different species (Human, Mouse, Chicken, Frog, Zebrafish, Cow, Horse, and Pig) downloaded from UniProt. Perform a multiple sequence alignment using the MUSCLE algorithm. Once the alignment is complete, save the aligned result as a ClustalW format file named 'hemoglobin_alignment.aln' in ~/UGENE_Data/results/. The alignment should show conserved regions across species and reveal evolutionary relationships between the hemoglobin beta proteins.

metadata.data_source: UniProt hemoglobin beta subunit sequences (P68871, P02088, P02112, P02132, Q90485, P02070, P02062, P02067)
